description.en: Type of vehicle: Crane truck Make: Mercedes-Benz Model: Sprinter 516 NGT (156 hp) Year of manufacture: 2014 Fuel: Gas Total weight: 5000 kg Equipment: Crane: Palfinger PC 2700 Year of manufacture of crane: 2013 Condition & comments: New batteries Audio System with Radio out of order. Worn front wiper blades. Steering wheel is crooked. Stone chips in the windshield. Traces of previous decoration. Door cracks and marks on the outside. Scratches, stains and marks on the inside. Worn steering wheel. Damaged upholstery on the front left. NOTE! Gas-powered vehicle with a total weight of 5000 kg. Rust, scuffs and scratches are present. See pictures for condition assessment.
